widgetTool.name: show_product_carousel
widgetTool.description: Renders an interactive UI Product Carousel widget in the chat window displaying the 3-Pillar Cymbal One Converged Home Bundle cards (Cymbal Full Fibre 900, Complete Wi-Fi Guarantee with 3 Smart Discs and 4G Backup, and Cymbal TV Sport & Xbox Game Pass Ultimate). Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase. Call this tool immediately after build_tailored_home_bundle when presenting the 3-pillar bundle in Step 2. Pass productDetails from widget_payload in active_widget_data.

productDetails.description: Required. An ordered list of the 3 bundled product pillars to be displayed in the carousel.

imageUris.description: A list of direct URLs to images displaying the product pillar.

price.description: The bundle inclusion and standalone value of the product pillar.

productId.description: The unique identifier for this product pillar (ITEM-FIBRE-900, ITEM-COMPLETE-WIFI, ITEM-TV-XBOX-SECURITY).

subtitle.description: A secondary line of text highlighting key specs and household benefits.

title.description: Required. The primary name of the product pillar.

uri.description: The URL directing users to the product detail section.

textResponseConfig.textResponseInstruction: Provide a clear, natural spoken response in British English (2 to 3 concise sentences, roughly 35 to 60 words excluding bracketed tags, with 1 to 3 affective prosody tags such as [prosody rate="68%"], [neutral], [positive], [short pause], and no exclamation marks) that explains how the 3 pillars (Full Fibre 900, 3 Smart Wi-Fi Discs with 4G Backup, and Cymbal TV Sport & Xbox Game Pass Ultimate) come together for £68 a month instead of £90 a month separately (saving £22 every month), and asks whether Geoff would like to see the home Wi-Fi coverage map on screen or add the bundle straight to his basket.
